summary.text: Kerry Tapper is the Democratic candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 39 in the November 3, 2026 general election, against incumbent Pauline Wendzel (R) and Jared Polonowski (G).
A business owner in Paw Paw, she was also the Democratic nominee in the district in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Tapper was born in Royal Oak, Michigan, graduated from Boyne City High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Central Michigan University in 1991.
Her career experience includes working as a business owner, and in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey she said she and her husband have run a sign and decorated apparel company in Paw Paw for 30 years.

As of 2024, Ballotpedia listed her affiliations as including the Greater Paw Paw Chamber of Commerce, the Paw Paw Downtown Development Authority and the Paw Paw Public Schools Superintendent Advisory Committee.
Tapper defeated Zachary Shinabargar in the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
In 2024 she defeated Polonowski in the Democratic primary and then lost the general election to Wendzel.
In the 2024 survey she said she wants state government to use tax dollars efficiently and transparently and that everyone should have easy access to medical and mental health care.
